title: Karen Blixen – National Museums of Kenya

facts.fact: The museum occupies the farmhouse used by author Karen Blixen, later opened as a museum in 1986.
The exhibitions include furniture and outdoors farming tools and original coffee processing equipment.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: Farm tools including a tractor from that period, wagons, ploughs and an original coffee processing factory equipment

facts.fact: The museum advertises guided tours, gardens and a nature trail with labelled trees.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: Guided tours are offered continuously ... Our trees are labeled to help in identification and learning.
